questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Probes cross-region DR for SAP HANA on AWS, combining SAP replication, immutable backups, DNS failover, and automated testing.

## Key Concepts
- SAP HANA System Replication (HSR) across regions
- AWS Route 53 failover and health checks
- S3 Object Lock + cross-region replication for backups
- SAP Backint/backup to S3 and DR automation (Step Functions, Lambda)
- IAM roles with least privilege for DR automation

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  DRAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service:
              - lambda.amazonaws.com
              - sfn.amazonaws.com
          Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: '/'
  DRAutomationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: DRAutomationPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref DRAutomationRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:ListBucket
          Resource: '*'
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets
            - route53:ListHostedZones
          Resource: '*'
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - ec2:DescribeInstances
            - ec2:StartInstances
            - ec2:StopInstances
          Resource: '*'
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test failover without impacting production traffic?
- What metrics would you collect to verify RPO/RTO during drills and how would you report them?

```yaml
Resources:

          - Effect: Allow
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```yaml
# CloudFormation snippet for a CMK and key policy
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPHanaCMK:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: SAP HANA cross-account CMK
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAdmins
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM Role and CloudWatch Alarm for SAP HANA EC2
Resources:
  SAPCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3LogArchival
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::sap-logs-archive/*
  CPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: sap-hana-cpu-high
      AlarmDescription: Alert when CPU exceeds 80%
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref SAP HANALinux
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic
```
